title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: 12. Notes that promotion policies contribute to the objectives of other European initiatives proposed by the Commission, in particular through support for the marketing of fruit and vegetables; notes that increasing the visibility of EU-grown legumes to consumers can contribute to strengthening European protein crop production, and to reducing dependency on imported protein crops; calls for specific promotion programmes for legumes and other plant-based proteins for direct human consumption;
